decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-34 INTRODUCE capturing allocation of the salary gap to permitted categories such as travel and consumable supplies.
The labor-calculation policy does not change the supplied allocated-budget values or their full-program-allocation basis.
The labor-calculation change does not alter schedule values; the separate message-34 instruction to apply FCC dates everywhere is already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
Choosing a calculation method for FCC and 154Q/201 does not itself entail a change to the independently tracked requirement that a salary and wages support sheet be included.
The calculation-method decision does not affect site naming; the separate message-34 naming decision is already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
The instruction not to inflate labor inputs leaves the previously established four-week value unchanged.
The labor-calculation policy has no effect on the required signature or its placement.
Allocating a labor-cost gap to permitted categories does not necessarily change or extend the separate explanatory text requirement.
